The next Java ILP Community Call is Wednesday, January 29th, 2019 at 5pm UTC (9am PST).

This call is open to anyone who would like to discuss ILP on the Java platform, but will also include discussion around the Quilt library and Java Connector. Previous call recordings can be found here.

Please respond to this post if you would like to add more items to discuss! Here’s the current agenda:

Agenda

  1. Introductions
  2. Discuss New open Quilt issues & PRs since Jan 15th.
  3. Discuss OPay
  4. Q&A, misc issues
